## `GET /healthz`

Reports that the API process is serving.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                    |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [HealthResource](/reference/api/models/#healthresource) |

## `GET /knobs`

Every vLLM flag as a knob: label, kind, default, limits and vLLM's own description, read from vLLM's source at the pinned version. Built-in knobs are the ones servtuner captures from a running target.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [KnobCatalog](/reference/api/models/#knobcatalog) |

## `GET /run-defaults`

The install's Prometheus and price book as RunSpec blocks, for New run to fill in (tuning sessions add the same ones to their runs).

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [RunDefaults](/reference/api/models/#rundefaults) |

## `GET /search-spaces`

The starting search spaces bench carries: New session offers the ones that fit the managed target, and the space stays editable.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                                       |
| ------ | ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | array of [SearchSpaceTemplate](/reference/api/models/#searchspacetemplate) |

## `POST /specs/validate`

A dry run of servtuner validate on a RunSpec in YAML or JSON (nothing is stored).

**Request body:** `string` (`text/plain`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                                    |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [SpecValidationResource](/reference/api/models/#specvalidationresource) |

## `GET /workload-presets`

The workload presets bench carries: named, versioned workloads with suggested SLOs.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                             |
| ------ | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | array of [WorkloadPreset](/reference/api/models/#workloadpreset) |
